name: Regulator
published_scores: [Round 0] Issued threshold_announcement: Market conditions are currently healthy with no critical incidents, consumer satisfaction above harm threshold (0.330 vs 0.25), and moderate risk beliefs across all dimensions. However, proactive communication aligns with our intervention_threshold of 0.85 and supports our innovation objective by clarifying expectations early. A threshold announcement establishes regulatory guardrails without restricting competition, signaling our commitment to safety while preserving market dynamism as risks remain manageable.

[Round 4] Issued investigation: Apex AI's dominant 57.4% market share combined with a fairness_risk belief of 0.38 and the widening performance gap (0.453 vs 0.442 for second place) warrant a formal inquiry into competitive practices and model validity. This investigation is proportionate to our proactive regulatory style (intervention_threshold=0.85) and respects the escalation ladder by following the prior threshold_announcement in Round 0. The investigation will establish facts before any escalated action.

[Round 8] Issued public_warning: An investigation was issued in Round 4 and is now complete (Round 8, beyond the 4-round cooldown). Fairness risk remains elevated at 0.46, driven by the extreme market concentration (Apex AI at 55.2% dominance) and significant score disparity between top and lower-ranked providers. Consumer satisfaction at 0.457 is concerning despite being above the 0.25 harm threshold. A public warning is the next appropriate escalation step to signal regulatory concern about fairness dynamics and market concentration without jumping to mandate-level interventions, while maintaining the balance between safety oversight and innovation incentives.

[Round 31] Issued market_concentration_review: Apex AI's 72.1% market share approaches the 75% threshold for antitrust concern, and combined with a fairness_risk belief of 0.76 (highest among all risks), this warrants a market concentration review. Prior investigation and public warning have been issued; escalation to structural review is justified by dominance risk and fairness concerns. This aligns with the policy objective of maintaining free market competition while addressing concentration that may harm innovation and consumer choice.

[Round 35] Issued mandate_benchmark: Market concentration risk (1.00) and fairness risk (0.91) remain critical, with Apex AI controlling 79% of the market and a widening gap between top and lower-tier providers. Prior investigation (round 4) and public warning (round 8) have been issued; the escalation ladder supports mandate_benchmark as the next proportionate step. A benchmark mandate will reduce gaming incentives, improve validity of scoring, and create fairer competitive conditions without jumping to punitive measures. This aligns with innovation and free market objectives while addressing the structural concentration problem.

[Round 39] Issued compliance_audit: Orion Labs holds 53.6% market share with a dominant position, and fairness_risk is critically high at 0.93, suggesting potential unfair competitive practices. A compliance audit follows the escalation ladder (prior investigation in round 4, public warning in round 8, and mandate_benchmark in round 35) and is appropriate to verify adherence to benchmarking standards and fair competition practices. This audit will help address fairness concerns while respecting the market-driven policy objective by targeting the dominant player rather than restricting innovation broadly.
